pyqgis_plugin.name: MapThemeToolbox
pyqgis_plugin.description: Map Theme toolbox: Modify, Repair, Present themes, Sync and Auto-Save
pyqgis_plugin.about: A combined toolbar for managing QGIS Map Themes: modify mutual layer visibility across themes, repair broken layer paths, present themes with a single click, sync with Excel/CSV/GeoPackage, and auto-save the project on a timer. Compatible with QGIS 3.22+ and QGIS 4.x.

pyqgis_plugin.name: TUFLOW Studio
pyqgis_plugin.description: TUFLOW project management: root paths, file editor, and run logs
pyqgis_plugin.about: Docked panel plugin for TUFLOW modellers with project folder tracking, control file editor with syntax checking, and run log extraction.
pyqgis_plugin.changelog: v1.3.0: Editor: animated auto-save toggle switch; Alt+Shift+Up/Down multi-cursor editing; .bat syntax highlighting; collapsible file categories; BC database CSVs open as editable tables grouped by subfolder; keyword search across all command files; Logs tab shows Start Time column v1.2.4: Fixed dock panel reappearing on QGIS startup even though it should stay hidden until opened v1.2.3: Added feedback button ([?] in tab bar) to send bug reports and feedback via email v1.2.2: TCF checker no longer flags Log Folder/Output Folder or paths with << >> variables as missing files v1.2.1: Removed Inputs tab; TCF checker now detects typos in IF/ELSE IF keyword (e.g. Scneario) v1.2.0: Editor now includes .bat files; file list grouped by extension; dock starts hidden by default

pyqgis_plugin.name: Drain Design Toolbox
pyqgis_plugin.description: Toolbox for 1-D drain design (channel and pipe hydraulic analysis).
pyqgis_plugin.about: A QGIS plugin providing hydraulic analysis tools for 1-D drain design, starting with trapezoidal open-channel Manning/critical-flow analysis.

pyqgis_plugin.name: RORB Tools
pyqgis_plugin.description: RORB catchment preparation, control vector builder, and results viewer.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A combined RORB toolbox with three toolbar icons: (1) Create RORB Layers — layer templates; (2) Build RORB .catg — auto-name, check links, build RORB/URBS control vectors; (3) RORB Results Viewer — browse .out files, plot hydrographs, export critical events. Bundles pyromb>=0.3 for build tools — no separate install needed.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Attribute Table Functions
pyqgis_plugin.description: Adds Area, Length, X/Y coordinate and Export CSV buttons to the QGIS attribute table toolbar.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Adds toolbar buttons to every attribute table: Area (polygon), Length (line), X and Y (point) create virtual fields with configurable units, CRS and decimal precision; Export CSV writes the table (all or selected features) with WKT geometry. Buttons auto enable/disable based on the layer's geometry type. Uses ellipsoidal measurement so geographic (lat/lon) layers still produce correct metric values.
pyqgis_plugin.changelog: v1.0.0: Renamed plugin to "Attribute Table Functions"; unified toolbar with Area, Length, X, Y and Export CSV v0.5: Added Export CSV button v0.4: X/Y CRS choice (project CRS or WGS84 lat/lon) v0.3: Added X and Y coordinate buttons for point layers v0.2: User-configurable decimal precision (default 3) v0.1: Initial release with Area and Length buttons
